content.description: Key Responsibilities * Plan and execute daily hiring activities to meet the Delivery Associate manpower requirements at PVRD, TKQA and ERSD. * Source candidates through field visits, local networks, referrals, job portals, social media and recruitment advertisements. * Identify suitable candidates in delivery catchment areas and conduct initial screening for availability, location suitability, vehicle access and role expectations. * Explain job responsibilities, delivery process expectations, payout structure and applicable work conditions clearly to candidates. * Coordinate document collection, verification, onboarding formalities, training and deployment with the respective station teams. * Maintain a daily recruitment tracker covering leads, calls, walk-ins, interviews, selections, onboarding, joining and dropouts. * Follow up with selected candidates until they report for duty and support early-stage retention through regular engagement. * Work closely with Hub Managers and Operations teams to understand manpower gaps, route requirements and daily deployment plans. * Ensure that recruited Delivery Associates are onboarded under the company’s approved process and are managed in line with Whizzard/Mahindra Logistics standards and operational expectations. * Share daily and weekly hiring updates, challenges, market feedback and action plans with the reporting manager. * Support recruitment drives and manpower requirements at other assigned Kerala stations whenever required. Candidate Profile * Education: Minimum Plus Two; graduates are preferred. * Experience: 1–3 years of experience in field recruitment, delivery associate hiring, manpower sourcing or frontline staffing is preferred. Candidates with strong field-level sourcing ability may also be considered. * Skills: Good communication and negotiation skills; ability to engage with local communities; follow-up and coordination skills; basic MS Excel/Google Sheets and smartphone usage. * Mobility: Willingness to travel to assigned stations and conduct regular field visits. * Languages: Malayalam required; basic English communication is preferred. Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month Benefits: * Health insurance Work Location: On the road
